anatomy.coordinateSpace: source quadrant-local down up left right, 627 x 627 quadrants
anatomy.method: manual reconstructed cranium from temples, cheeks, jaw, ear insertion and hair part; not exposed skin or silhouette
anatomy.uncertainty: Occluded skull boundaries are manual estimates, approximately +/- 8-12 source pixels (back +/- 12); differences smaller than this are not certifiable height measurements.
anatomy.excluded: external ears, ponytails, hair volume, cowlick, crown, side coil, ribbons, jewels, cotton candy, trailing fabric
anatomy.directionReview: One uniform scale for all four views; no separate direction scaling; front/back clothing inference is documented.
